name: miyu-companion
description: Miyu — an animated desktop companion with local-first privacy and optional model connections. Native Desktop primary, Mobile native, Portable fallback.
author: Miyu Studio

scripts.package:win: node tools/build-portable.mjs && cd desktop && go run ./resourcegen && go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w -H windowsgui" -o ../deliverables/Miyu.exe .
scripts.build:linux: npm run build && npm run build:portable && cd desktop && go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../Miyu-Linux-x86_64 .
scripts.build:all: npm ci && npm run build && npm run build:portable
